description: This source file defines an asynchronous function 'runCallsiteGuard' that performs analysis on TypeScript files within a repository to identify callsites that do not meet certain allowed criteria. It uses utility functions to resolve paths and collect files, reads file contents, and reports violations.

methods.name: runCallsiteGuard
methods.description: Performs callsite analysis across TypeScript files in a repository, identifying violations based on provided parameters, and outputs results.
